verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a help-center heading, "Using Shopify POS offline", which shows some offline mode exists but says nothing about what it supports. The Tap to Pay page frames contactless payments as relying on WiFi or cellular connectivity, so offline card acceptance is not established. Missing for 10: evidence that card payments can be taken while offline, store-and-forward queuing and syncing of transactions on reconnect, any limits or risk terms on offline transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
